name: cloud-infrastructure-map
title: Cloud Infrastructure Map
description: A geographical edge location matrix displaying active points of presence, latency pings, and redundancy.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Cloud Infrastructure Map Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
